title: HTB: MakeSense
caption: The WebAgency site on makesense.htb.
description: MakeSense starts with a WordPress agency site whose voice-message widget encrypts submissions with a key shipped in its own JavaScript. Forging a payload gives stored XSS in wp-admin, a rogue administrator and a plugin webshell. Reused credentials give SSH, and a root-owned OCR app turns a picture of PHP into root.
